summary: Bending Spoons S.p.A., an Italian tech firm, filed a Form 6-K on August 13, 2026, reporting Q2 2026 results and subsequent events, including completion of an IPO on Nasdaq (symbol BSP) raising $1.10 billion, a definitive agreement to acquire Airtable for $1.29 billion enterprise value, and related financing. No specific deal terms for Airtable are given in this excerpt. The filing is primarily a routine earnings disclosure, but the notable post-quarter acquisitions and IPO create strategic context. What to watch: closing conditions and regulatory approvals for Airtable acquisition, and integration of Tractive.
